thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem — recurring partial responses + TCP timeouts on chatstream. I'm creating a short action list and owners. TL;DR: two-pronged: client reconnect/backoff hardening + server-side streaming retry and metrics. See below.

ajay: +1. I'll own reconnect/backoff changes in the SDKs (node + python). Plan: add jittered exponential backoff + cap, and increase handshake timeout from 2s -> 6s. Target branch and draft PR by Fri.

tara: I'll own server-side mitigations. Hypothesis: worker restart / scale events sometimes cause session reattachment failures that surface as partial responses. Plan: implement drain-on-restart + session-sticky routing and a gentle per-session grace window. ETA end of sprint (2w).

kevin: I'll own observability and synthetic tests. Will add per-session chunk-latency histograms, 'stream.partial_rate', and a flaky-network synthetic that toggles network at 1-5s intervals. ETA Wed.

maria: For interim mitigations: can we auto-fallback users to the polling (non-streaming) endpoint and show a retry banner? We should reduce customer impact while we fix infra.

ajay: Yes — SDK will expose autoFallback: true by default for 2 weeks. Heuristic: if stream silence > 10s after initial tokens, fall back to poll. Implementing a local heuristic + telemetry to avoid false positives. Patch in 48h.

tara: Add a runbook entry for on-call: before restarting a worker, run a quick query on 'stream.partial_rate' and call the graceful restart path: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/streaming-worker -n prod``` then monitor 'stream.partial_rate' and 'session.reconnect_success' for 15m.

ops-jen: I'll schedule remedial on-call rota for the next 2 weeks. Who wants to be primary contact week1?

ajay: I can take week1 primary.

tara: I'll take week2 primary. kevin will be backup for both weeks.

maria: Timelines recap: SDK autoFallback + handshake timeout bump -> 48h (ajay). Observability dashboards + synth -> Wed (kevin). Server-side drain & sticky routing -> end of sprint + verification (tara). Please drop PR links, playbook updates, and task cards in #incidents and tag me.

sre-bot: Reminder: create follow-up Jira ticket INF-8212 and assign to owners. Deadline autopopulated 2026-03-30.

kevin: INF-8212 created. Dashboards posted: https://grafana.redwood/in/d/streaming/streaming-health (viewers: eng, sre).

ajay: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5423 (SDK backoff + fallback heuristic). Please review.

tara: Server RFC and proposed rollout plan here: https://docs.redwood/internal/streaming-retry-rfc.md (includes canary gating and health checks).

maria: Reconvene Monday 09:30 PT for status and blockers. If anything blocks, ping me directly.

ajay: noted :thumbsup:

tara: Added detailed checklist to INF-8212 and linked smoke test runbook.

ops-jen: Rota updated: https://oncall.redwood/rota/streaming. Week1: ajay primary, kevin backup. Week2: tara primary, kevin backup.

maria: Thanks all — closing this thread for now. Owners: update this thread with progress and postmortem follow-ups in INF-8212.
